literal_meaning: আকাশে তোলা (lifting or raising to the sky)
figurative_meaning_en: To excessively praise someone beyond what they deserve
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বন্ধু তার ছোট্ট সাফল্যের জন্য তাকে আকাশে তুলে দিচ্ছে।
এতটা আকাশে তোলা করো না, সে তো এখনও শিখছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His friend is raising him to the skies for his minor achievement.
Don't praise him to the skies so much; he's still learning.
note: The idiom warns against undue flattery, common in Bengali oral traditions.
